sign_convention: Delta = configuration - reference; negative Delta means the configuration is worse

test_definitions.paired_bootstrap: 10,000 resamples, seed 20240917, two-sided empirical p-value, 95% percentile CI; identical implementation to Table 2
test_definitions.mcnemar_exact: exact two-sided McNemar on the binary complete-evidence hit indicator (a question counts as a hit iff its top-k list contains all of its gold documents); config_wins / ref_wins are the discordant pairs

weights.reference_note: sweep row carrying the deployed dense weight (w_v = 0.4); the deployed pair (0.4, 0.5) is not on the w_v + w_g = 1 grid used by the sweep

r1_range.description: R@1 spread across the whole weight sweep

r10_monotonic_steps.description: stepwise Recall@10 change as w_g increases; Delta = (higher w_g) - (lower w_g)

wg_0.8_to_1.0_v1_vs_v4.description: the w_g = 0.8 -> 1.0 step, in the submitted version and in the present version; Delta = (w_g=1.0) - (w_g=0.8), so a negative value is a drop

v1_reviewer_arithmetic.note: A net gain of 2 questions with no discordant-pair compensation can never reach significance at the 5% level; the reviewer's 'at least 0.50' is exact.

v1_bottomup.note: the 4.00 pp Recall@10 gain on a 50-question benchmark with 2 gold documents per question is a net gain of 2 questions
